name: flaui
description: Skills for setting up FlaUI for Python, finding and driving Windows UI elements, writing pytest UI tests and debugging flaky automation.

interface.shortDescription: Windows desktop UI automation with FlaUI for Python
interface.longDescription: Guidance for FlaUI for Python, the PythonNet port of FlaUI: install and bridge setup, UIA2 vs UIA3, finding elements with the condition factory and XPath, acting through UIA patterns, post_wait and Retry, pytest UI tests with element maps, and debugging flaky Windows UI automation.
defaultPrompt: Write a FlaUI for Python script that launches my Windows app and fills in a form
